files.patch:
diff --git a/src/pricing.js b/src/pricing.js
index e0ddcd1..05fa831 100644
--- a/src/pricing.js
+++ b/src/pricing.js
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 function linePrice(item) {
-  return item.price
+  const qty = Number.isInteger(item.qty) && item.qty > 0 ? item.qty : 1
+  return item.price * qty
 }
 
 function discount(amount, percent) {

diff --git a/test/pricing.test.js b/test/pricing.test.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b7f4505
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/pricing.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+const { test } = require('node:test')
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict')
+const { linePrice } = require('../src/pricing.js')
+
+test('missing quantity counts once', () => {
+  assert.equal(linePrice({ price: 7 }), 7)
+})
+
+test('quantity multiplies', () => {
+  assert.equal(linePrice({ price: 7, qty: 3 }), 21)
+})
